CustomField.description: A numeric value that represents the size of the zip code. This is loaded when a realignment is requested. It can vary based on need (# of open independents OR # of x opportunities OR cash sales dollars, etc). This helps assess equity of workload across realigned territories

It can vary based on need (# of open independents OR # of x opportunities OR cash sales dollars, etc). This helps assess equity of workload across realigned territories.
